topic: CORDIS states Regions4Climate (44+ partners) develops tools and collaborative practices so European regions can build evidence-based risk and vulnerability analyses and resilience plans — they need interoperable, trustworthy hazard and exposure data to feed their system-dynamic modelling and decision tools.
institution: Teknologian tutkimuskeskus VTT Oy (VTT Technical Research Centre of Finland)
hydrashield_relevance: Offer HydraShield's evidence-labelled multi-hazard dashboards and data layers as decision-support input for Regions4Climate's twelve regional resilience plans.
evidence: Interoperable, evidence-labelled hazard and exposure datasets plus historical event records to power Regions4Climate's risk and vulnerability analyses and regional resilience dashboards.
recommended_strategy: Offer HydraShield's evidence-labelled multi-hazard dashboards and data layers as decision-support input for Regions4Climate's twelve regional resilience plans.
